name: marquee
title: Marquee
description: A measured moving list with optional perspective and a rhythm that follows scrolling.

props.name: pixelsPerSecond
props.description: Override the named pace with 0–160 CSS pixels per second.

props.name: scrollTarget
props.description: Omit to follow document scrolling. The target should be mounted with the marquee.

props.name: tiltX
props.description: Depth presentation only. Perspective also scales to the viewport to keep the strip continuous.
